page_actions.open_event_listings: opens an event page with the page's own quantity URL and reads its listings
page_actions.set_ticket_quantity: answers the event page's 'How many tickets?' prompt or chooses in its quantity menu
page_actions.set_listing_sort: chooses an entry in the event page's sort menu
page_actions.set_listing_filters: sets the event page's zone, price, deal score and perks filters or presses Clear
page_actions.show_more_listings: scrolls the event page's listings panel so it loads more rows
